It is completely normal to feel a twinge of jealousy when your partner has a close relationship with their mother. Often, this stems from feeling like you are competing for his time, attention, or approval. A good first step is to gently explore what specifically triggers these feelings. Is it the amount of time they spend together, or perhaps feeling like your opinions are secondary to hers? 

Once you identify the root of the jealousy, try having an open, non-accusatory conversation with your boyfriend. Use "I" statements, like "I feel a bit left out when..." rather than criticizing his mother. It can also help to remind yourself that the love he has for his mother and the romantic love he has for you are entirely different; one does not diminish the other. Building your own gentle rapport with her, at a comfortable pace, might also help you see her as an ally rather than competition.
